title: every feature checks its own growth, and a change reruns only the benches it reaches

stages.title: growth is a feature proof
stages.summary: Makes every feature's perf proof run the growth ramp over its bench, with valgrind only as the fallback for an unclear result.

shapes: Feature proofs — an example, an attack, a bench, a `covers:` marker

stages.title: small benches, and a budget
stages.summary: Lowers every bench's iteration count to what its growth check needs, and keeps the bench tree from growing back.

stages.title: a change reruns the benches it reaches
stages.summary: Gives every bench a footprint, so the tooling knows which benches a change reaches and reruns their perf proof.

stages.title: skip what is already proven
stages.summary: Stops rerunning benches once the code a change touched is proven by the first benches that reach it.

stages.title: what the user reads
stages.summary: Adds a plain section on the growth proof to `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`, and leaves the roster owing nothing.

checks.name: the perf proof judges a feature's growth, and valgrind is only its fallback
want: a bench whose cost per operation rises as its batches double fails its perf proof
a bench that grows faster than its declared complexity fails its perf proof
a bench with no declared complexity fails its perf proof
valgrind runs only when the ramp shows no clear growth
nv verify never runs valgrind over a bench

checks.name: every bench's iteration count is no larger than its growth check needs
want: every bench's iteration count is no larger than its growth check needs

checks.name: the bench tree's counted work is within its budget
want: the bench tree's counted work is within its budget

checks.name: a change selects the benches it reaches, and only those
want: a change to code a bench reaches selects that bench
a change no bench reaches selects no bench
a bench whose figure the change made stale is owed until it runs

checks.name: benches behind already-proven items are skipped, and a degradation runs them all
want: a bench whose changed items are all proven is skipped and its figure carried
an item fewer than two benches reach runs every bench that reaches it
a degradation runs every bench that reaches the same changed items
the same change always picks the same benches

checks.name: docs/perf/performance-pass.md has its growth proof section
argv: const t=require('fs').readFileSync('docs/perf/performance-pass.md','utf8');if(!t.includes('## The growth proof')){console.log('missing: ## The growth proof');process.exit(1)}console.log('the summary has its growth proof section')
want: the summary has its growth proof section

checks.name: the whole roster owes nothing, growth included
want: nothing owed in the whole roster
